commercialPurpose: Explain a service or product benefit with human/workspace proof and a short checklist rather than another card grid.
purposeLayer: The split panel gives substance after feature bullets by pairing proof imagery with outcome copy.
anatomyLayer: Large image half, text half, headline, paragraph, compact icon checklist, and muted background band.
hierarchyLayer: Image context and headline share first focus, checklist confirms details second, paragraph supports third.
gridRhythmLayer: Two-column split band, often alternating image/text side, with strong horizontal section break.
densityLimitLayer: Use one primary image, one headline, one short paragraph, and 3-5 checklist bullets.
originalityLayer: Learn split proof-plus-checklist composition; transform image role, band color, bullet system, and side order.
usageRuleLayer: Use when a landing page needs a narrative break between dense features and CTA pressure.
layoutGesture: split proof image with checklist benefit copy
sectionSilhouette: half-bleed image panel paired with calm text panel
compositionTension: large human/workspace image balances compact checklist logic
focalPath: image context to headline to checklist bullets
negativeSpaceShape: rectangular calm text field beside dense image crop
depthLayering: image plane against flat tinted content surface
moduleScaleVariation: one oversized image with small bullet rows
breakoutBehavior: image can bleed to section edge while text stays contained
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact office photo, pale blue-gray band, mint check icons, or copy wording.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 002 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until exact hyper-accuracy review and dedupe rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact Pallas editorial visuals, startup hero background, coral/teal color identity, photo assets, sidebar widget order, or footer treatment.
